fields.title: Board round chapter ratings: agreement between auditors (example)

sample.caseTitle: Can we trust our Flow Manual audit, and where should we focus?
sample.look: Auditors A and B agree well with the standard. Auditor C is less consistent, even with themselves, so retrain them on the Challenger and attendance standards before trusting their wards’ results.
